label: final copy step of length-3 sequences, plus near-end copy steps with input r
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase; it never fires on original or delimiter steps, or at recall_idx 0-1. Two components. (1) The last output step (t=5) of L=3 sequences: 98% precision, about 46% of the activation mass, and it holds nearly all of the top quartile, with the strongest examples when the fed-back input is r or 3. (2) Copy steps near the end of the sequence (to_go <= 2) where the fed-back input is r, at any L. Activation leans heavily toward the last one or two outputs in general (69% of mass at to_go=0), and inputs x, o and 3 also raise the rate, but it is too weak and diffuse to capture well. Magnitudes are small overall (max 0.019). Dev F1 is 0.52 and mass recall 0.74; many low-magnitude activations at late copy steps of longer sequences are missed.
